verdict.rationale: The closest first-party evidence is the Multi-Client MCP, which lets firms work across selected clients in a single AI conversation. Multi-location payroll also runs one payroll across employees in several work locations. Both suggest some cross-item, batch-style operation, but neither documents general bulk actions such as mass edits, bulk imports or batch updates through the AI, MCP or CLI surfaces. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation capability (batch create/update/delete across employees or records), documentation of bulk actions via CLI/MCP/API, limits or scope of bulk changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
